tasks.short: Check renting and advertising with authorities

steps.what: Confer with legal authorities about the properties
Ensure properties comply with state and federal regulations
Ensure renting and advertising practices are not discriminatory

tasks.design: The manager confers with legal authorities to ensure that renting and advertising practices are not discriminatory and that properties comply with state and federal regulations. The applicable rules are those in force for that property. Nothing is decided by {DOCS}. The conference and both judgements stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager calls the authority and judges the practice.
tasks.enabler_now: No checklist replaces the conversation or the judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether a practice is discriminatory stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not treat a missing document as a refusal of a tenant.
tasks.altitude: The conference stays the work. The manager applies the rules in force for that property.

reach.task: Explain the rule that applies to this property
reach.learn: Which practices the adviser says must change.

evidence.claim: Conferring with an authority and judging a renting or advertising practice stay manual.
Rules against discriminatory renting and advertising differ by country. The manager applies the rules in force for that property.

assumptions: The work starts with a practice to check and ends when the manager has conferred and judged, or stops.
The words state and federal are the layers named in the task. The rules used are those in force for that property, in a generic European organisation, not a filing process invented for one country.
No applicant is scored. A missing document is not a refusal. Upkeep is zero.
research_questions: Which practices did the authority say must change?

already_counted.description: Judging compliance with the regulations is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conference adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every practice is still judged in the conference. High: the same conference remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Negotiate a sale, lease, or development

steps.what: Negotiate the sale, lease, or development of property
Complete the appropriate documents and forms
Review those documents and forms before filing
File the accepted documents and forms

tasks.design: The manager negotiates the sale, lease, or development of property and completes or reviews the appropriate documents and forms. The negotiation and the completion stay at full effort. {DOCS} files only the forms the manager has accepted. A blank figure stays blank and is not filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager negotiated, completed the forms, and then filed them.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted form can be filed as written.
tasks.still_hard: Negotiating the deal and completing the form stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not file a form that still has a blank price or a blank party.
tasks.altitude: The form is filed only after the manager accepts that version. The negotiation stays theirs.

reach.task: Agree the price and the parties
reach.learn: Which terms the owner will not sign.

evidence.claim: An accepted form can be filed as written. Negotiating the deal and completing the form stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a sale, lease, or development to negotiate and ends when the accepted forms are filed or the manager stops.
The form has the parties, the property identifier, and the price, completed by the manager from the negotiation. A blank price is left blank and is not filed.
The file uses the forms accepted in the review. A later change of a term voids that acceptance.
unknowns: Which forms the authority requires for this kind of deal.
research_questions: How often did the review stop a form because a party or a price was blank?

already_counted.description: Negotiating the sale, lease, or development is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a figure on a form before the manager accepts it.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the negotiation is the work, so filing is a small part. High: terms are agreed, the forms are reviewed, and only then filed. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Choose architectural firms and the brief for new structures
Review the contract before it is sent
Send the accepted contract for detailed plans

tasks.design: The manager contracts with architectural firms to draw up detailed plans for new structures. The manager chooses the firm and the brief, and reviews the contract. {EMAIL} sends only the accepted contract. The firm draws the plans. A blank fee stays blank and is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager chose the firm, wrote the contract, and sent it.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted contract can be sent as written.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the firm and the brief stays with the manager. The plans stay with the firm.
tasks.human_edge: The manager will not send a contract with a blank fee or a blank site.
tasks.altitude: The contract is sent only after the manager accepts that version. The plans are not drawn here.

reach.learn: Which parts of the brief the firm cannot meet.

evidence.claim: An accepted contract can be sent to an architectural firm. Choosing the firm and the brief stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a new structure to plan and ends when the accepted contract is sent or the manager stops.
The draft has the firm, the site, and the fee, written by the manager. A blank fee is left blank and is not sent.
The send uses the contract accepted in the review. Drawing the plans is the firm's work, not this task.
unknowns: Which firms the owner will consider.
research_questions: How often did the review change the fee before sending?

already_counted.description: Choosing the architectural firm and the brief is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct the brief before the contract is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the brief is still written by hand, so sending is only the dispatch. High: the contract is accepted and sent, and choosing the firm remains. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List which stored documents are present or missing
Determine and certify eligibility of prospective tenants
Review that certification following government regulations

tasks.design: The manager determines and certifies the eligibility of prospective tenants, following government regulations. {DOCS} only lists which required documents are present or missing. A missing document stays missing and is not a refusal. The manager decides, reviews the certification, and only the accepted version is written.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager checked the papers and wrote the certification by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Document identifiers already stored can be listed as present or missing. The accepted certification can be written as text.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding eligibility stays with the manager. The list is not a decision.
tasks.human_edge: The manager will not certify a tenant when a required fact is blank.
tasks.altitude: The certification is written only after the manager accepts that version. The document list does not decide.

reach.task: Bring a document that is missing
reach.learn: Which document the tenant says was already provided.

evidence.claim: A stored document identifier can be listed as present or missing. The manager certifies eligibility and accepts the text before it is written.
Deciding whether a person may rent is a decision about that person. National rules differ on what may be asked and stored.

assumptions: The work starts with an application and ends when the accepted certification is written or the manager stops.
An application has a tenant identifier and document identifiers, entered by the manager from papers the tenant brought. A missing document is listed as missing and is not treated as a refusal.
The write uses the certification accepted in the review. The document list does not score the tenant and does not certify them.
unknowns: Which documents the regulations require for this kind of letting.
research_questions: How often did the manager refuse to certify because a fact was blank?

already_counted.description: Determining eligibility of prospective tenants is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a document-present flag after the manager sees the paper.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the decision is the work, so writing the accepted text is a small part. High: documents are listed, the manager certifies and reviews, and only then is it written. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still inspects sites, meets people, and decides rents, eligibility, and staff matters. A payment, contract, purchase, advertisement, or record is sent or written only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An owner receives only a budget or a payment list the manager has accepted.
A contractor receives only a bid request or a contract the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when an amount, a date, or a required document is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a send or a write.
Keep site inspections, tenant conversations, and eligibility decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every property has a budget and a record the owner can trust, and the manager still decides the exception.
